characters.description: The Dragon Rider bonded to Saphira, now a seasoned warrior and the Varden's greatest hope. Bearing the sword Brisingr and the accumulated training of the elves, he leads and fights at the front of the rebellion as it drives toward the Empire's heart, knowing that only he and Saphira might stand against the tyrant king in the end.
characters.name: Eragon

characters.description: Eragon's blue dragon and partner, mighty in battle and fiercely proud, one of the last free dragons in the world. She carries Eragon into war, shares his every thought, and understands that the survival of dragonkind itself may rest on how the coming struggle ends.
characters.name: Saphira

characters.description: Eragon's cousin, now a bold and resourceful captain in the Varden, married to Katrina. Fighting with a hammer and a sharp tactical mind, he wins hard victories for the rebellion and is prepared to risk everything for his family and the cause.
characters.name: Roran

characters.description: Roran's wife, rescued from the Empire's servants, steadfast and courageous as she follows the Varden's war and awaits the child she and Roran are expecting.
characters.name: Katrina

characters.description: The commanding leader of the Varden, guiding the alliance of humans, dwarves, elves, and others in a bid to topple the Empire. Brave and politically astute, she bears enormous personal risk to keep the rebellion moving toward the capital and the king who rules it.
characters.name: Nasuada

characters.description: The elf envoy and warrior, close ally and companion to Eragon. Reserved, principled, and deadly in a fight, she carries heavy responsibilities for her people as the war reaches its climax and the fate of the elves is drawn into the balance.
characters.name: Arya

characters.description: Eragon's estranged kin, a Rider of the red dragon Thorn, enslaved to the king by binding oaths. Powerful, resentful, and trapped, he serves the Empire against his will and stands as one of the last great obstacles between the Varden and victory.
characters.name: Murtagh

characters.description: Eragon's dwarf friend, now king of his people, bringing the dwarves' strength to the alliance. Loyal and steadfast, he leads his nation into the decisive stage of the war against the Empire.
characters.name: Orik

characters.description: The tyrant king of the Empire, an ancient renegade Dragon Rider of overwhelming sorcerous power hoarded over generations. The final enemy of the cycle, he rules from his fortress capital through fear, enslaved servants, and unbreakable oaths, and confronting him is the last and gravest task the Varden face.
characters.name: Galbatorix
